personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK with an energetic African-modern radio vibe
personality_one_liner: A high-performance, dark-first operational surface where live radio metrics, cinematic VOD thumbnails, and energetic amber accents take center stage.

spacing.rule: Dense and operational. Use md (12pt) for internal card padding, lg (16pt) for screen edges. Minimal wasted space, emphasizing large thumbnails and readable metrics.

do's: Use heavily tinted blur for the persistent mini-player positioned above the tab bar.
Use blur on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Apply gradient-to-dark scrim over all cinematic VOD thumbnails before placing text.
dont's: Do not use blur on standard VOD cards or list rows.
Do not make the blur too transparent; ensure underlying content is abstracted.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Brand reveal with a vibrant energetic gradient or dark background holding the station logo.

states.loading: Dark background with a subtle pulsing brandPrimary border around the logo.

screens.layout: Centered logo (use fallback if PNG unavailable) on a deep #0F0F13 canvas with a subtle vertical gradient (surface to slightly darker surface). A 'BB FM Kigali' wordmark in Barlow Condensed.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Educate the user on Live Radio, VOD, and Premium Podcasts.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery for each slide. Required: gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom fade ending at >=70% surface) over the image. Text and primary CTA (brandPrimary) sit in the bottom 30%.

screens.name: PhoneEntry
screens.purpose: Secure authentication starting with phone number.

states.error: Inline error text below the input.

screens.layout: Large Barlow Condensed header. Single-column input. Sticky CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: OTPVerify

states.error: Shake animation and red error text.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Command center for the radio station, featuring Live Radio status and featured content.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks for the featured shows and schedule.

screens.layout: Header with user greeting. Hero section displaying current 'ON AIR' show (large Barlow Condensed text, brandPrimary 'LIVE' badge). Horizontal scrolling carousel for 'Upcoming Schedule' and 'Featured News'. Persistent mini-player component sits fixed at the bottom above the tab bar.

screens.name: Shows

states.empty: Icon + 'No shows available in this category.'

screens.layout: Sticky header with horizontally scrolling chip row for categories (All, Podcasts, VOD, Interviews). Below, a 2-column grid of VOD thumbnails. Each thumbnail MUST have a gradient scrim and title text at the bottom. The persistent mini-player remains visible above the tab bar.

screens.name: News
screens.layout: Vertical scroll list of news cards. Each card has a leading thumbnail (left) and text (right). Clean surfaceSecondary containers with 1pt divider.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Header with Avatar (Initials). Sections for 'Subscription Status' (shows current tier with a prominent upgrade CTA if Basic), 'Payment History', and 'Settings'. Use surfaceSecondary rows.

screens.name: FullRadioPlayer
screens.layout: Modal full-screen sheet. Large album/DJ artwork taking up top 50% with a heavy bottom gradient scrim. Bottom half contains track/DJ info (Barlow Condensed), wave animation or progress bar, and large playback controls.

screens.name: VideoPlayer

states.loading: Spinner in the center of the video block.

screens.layout: Top 30-40% is the WebView/Video player (supports Admin YouTube/Vimeo URLs). Bottom 60% contains Title, Description, and a 'More Like This' horizontal carousel.

screens.name: SubscriptionPaywall
screens.layout: Sales-focused page. Top 'hero benefit' headline. 2 vertical cards for plans (Basic and Premium). Premium card should have a 1.5pt borderStrong outline and a 'RECOMMENDED' badge in brandTertiary. Sticky 'Continue to Payment' button at the bottom.

screens.name: CheckoutMethod
screens.layout: List of surfaceSecondary rows representing Stripe, PayPal, MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money. Simple radio button selection. Sticky 'Pay [Amount]' CTA at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility (7) guidelines: avoid large empty spaces, emphasize operational density, use Barlow Condensed for numbers/titles/metrics and Satoshi for readability.
Banned Colors: Any shade of blue, indigo, or purple. Use #FF6B00 (Amber/Rust) as the single brand primary color.
The persistent mini-player must be placed OUTSIDE the scroll views of individual tab screens, residing directly above the bottom tab bar. Apply a glassmorphism (expo-blur) effect to it.
For the Shows (VOD) screen, implement the category chips as a horizontally scrolling row nested within a sticky header.
For the SubscriptionPaywall, ensure the Premium tier card visually stands out using the `borderStrong` token and a `brandTertiary` background tint.
All VOD thumbnails MUST use the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top to bottom fade ending at >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast.
Use WebView for video rendering to support Admin URLs (YouTube/Vimeo) in the VideoPlayer screen.
Apply `KeyboardAvoidingView` to the authentication and checkout screens to keep the primary CTA anchored above the keyboard.
Research learnings: Mobile VOD discovery relies heavily on horizontal chip filters and scannable 2-column grids rather than single-row carousels for deep catalogs. Apply this on the Shows screen.
